swayable.summary: A speaker argues the Senate filibuster blocks needed legislation and calls for broad democracy reform including voting rights and redistricting. The message is delivered as a direct, passionate speech with audience applause.
swayable.title: The Senate Is Where Good Laws Go to Die

traits.change: Add an opening line such as: 'As a veteran who served this country, I know what it means when the system fails the people it's supposed to protect.'

traits.quote: whether it's the Supreme Court or it's the filibuster or it's the way we cut our districts apart
traits.change: To drop it, remove the list of opposing forces and replace with: 'The filibuster is the single biggest obstacle we face right now.'
The script alone cannot show this; shoot the video in a formal setting with professional lighting and clear audio rather than a casual room.

traits.quote: if you ever left tea in a cooling saucer for way too long, it dries up
traits.change: To drop it, remove the tea-saucer metaphor and replace with: 'The Senate has become a place where legislation stalls indefinitely.'
Add an introduction line such as: 'I'm [Name], and I serve in the United States Senate,' so the viewer knows the speaker holds elected office.
Add a line such as: 'I watched a bill I fought for years die in the Senate because one senator hid behind the filibuster and never had to explain why.'
Add a closing line such as: 'Vote for candidates who will abolish the filibuster and restore democracy for all of us.'

traits.quote: I believe we have to abolish the filibuster
traits.change: To drop it, soften to: 'There are strong arguments for reconsidering the filibuster as part of broader reform.'

traits.quote: it allows senators who don't want to take hard votes to hide behind the filibuster of just one senator, usually in a safe seat
traits.change: To drop it, remove the explanation of how the filibuster works and go straight to: 'The filibuster has to go.'
Add a line such as: 'Voters in my district have told me they feel completely unheard because their senator never has to answer for a filibuster vote.'
Add a line such as: 'I'm proud that more Americans than ever are demanding a democracy that actually works for them, and that gives me real hope.'
Add a line such as: 'Since 2000, the filibuster has been used more than in the entire previous century combined,' which most viewers are unlikely to know.
Add a light line such as: 'One senator can hold the whole country hostage from a safe seat — if that's not a punchline, I don't know what is.' To keep the tone serious, leave this out.
Add an introduction from a well-known public figure such as: 'I'm [Celebrity Name], and I'm asking you to listen to this message about our democracy.'

traits.quote: we've just seen the biggest assault from the Supreme Court on the Voting Rights Act in our history
traits.change: To drop it, replace with: 'The Supreme Court has made significant changes to the Voting Rights Act that we need to address through legislation.'
The speech sounds natural and conversational; to make it sound more scripted, rewrite it with formal sentence structures and remove the tea metaphor and the mid-sentence asides.
Add a line such as: 'I've heard from voters across this country who say they finally feel seen when their senator has to stand up and cast a real vote.'

traits.quote: it allows senators who don't want to take hard votes to hide behind the filibuster of just one senator, usually in a safe seat
traits.change: To drop it, remove the explanation of how the filibuster operates mechanically and keep only the call to abolish it.

traits.quote: we need to be thinking about broad picture democracy reform
traits.change: To drop the positive tone, remove the forward-looking reform framing and end on: 'Right now our democracy is broken and the damage is severe.'

traits.quote: the Senate has become the place where all legislation goes to die
traits.change: To drop the negative tone, replace with: 'The Senate has the potential to be a place where we pass the legislation Americans need.'
The script does not indicate this; to add it, film the speaker on a phone in a casual setting with natural background noise and no editing.
Add a line such as: 'According to the Brennan Center, filibuster use has increased tenfold since the 1970s,' and show the source on screen.
Add on-screen text displaying key phrases such as 'ABOLISH THE FILIBUSTER' and 'BIGGEST ASSAULT ON VOTING RIGHTS' as the speaker says them.
Add a line from an ordinary voter such as: 'My neighbor lost her healthcare because one senator used the filibuster and never had to explain it to anyone.'

traits.quote: I believe we have to abolish the filibuster
traits.change: To drop it, replace with a neutral framing: 'Some argue the filibuster should be abolished; others disagree — here are the facts.'
Add a line such as: 'It is a deeply serious moment when the tools of democracy are used to silence the will of the people.'
Add a line such as: 'If we don't act now, we risk losing the right to vote in free and fair elections altogether.'
Add an animated sequence showing a bill moving through the Senate and getting blocked by a single senator to illustrate how the filibuster works.
